title: Suspicious sign-in handling
steps: Verify the report through an approved channel.
Escalate to the security team when appropriate.
Do not reset credentials or revoke sessions without approval.

title: VPN connection troubleshooting
steps: Verify correct VPN client and endpoint.
Check documented account status and error message.

title: Slow laptop first checks
steps: Record device symptoms and affected applications.
Check available disk space and resource usage.
Confirm maintenance windows before restarting or installing software.

title: Password reset request process
steps: Verify requester identity using the approved procedure.
Never request or expose an existing password.
Route the reset to an authorised technician or self-service process.
